claims.why_uncovered: Neither the asset.placed question nor the asset.quarter question tells the filer which date counts as the placed-in-service date. For property converted from personal use, the placed-in-service date is the conversion date, not the purchase date. For other property, it is the date the property is ready and available for use, not the date it is first used. The asset.cost question mentions conversion only to set the basis (the smaller of adjusted basis or fair market value), and the screen refuses only conversions made in 2025. A filer who converted property in an earlier year, or who bought it in one year and readied it in another, could therefore enter the wrong year or quarter. That error changes the recovery year used with the tables, whether the property is a 2025 asset eligible for section 179 and the special allowance, and the mid-quarter test.
